When an osd request is set to linger
column2: the osd client holds onto the

column1: request so it can be re-submitted following certain osd map changes.
The osd client holds a reference to the request until it is
unregistered.  This is used by rbd for watch requests.
Currently
column2: the reference is taken when the request is marked with

column1: the linger flag.  This means that if an error occurs after that
time but before the the request completes successfully
reference is leaked.
There's really no reason to take the reference until the request is
registered in the the osd client's list of lingering requests
that only happens when the lingering (watch) request completes
successfully.
So take that reference only when it gets registered following
succesful completion
column2: and drop it (as before) when the request

column1: gets unregistered.  This avoids the reference problem on error
in rbd.
Rearrange ceph_osdc_unregister_linger_request() to avoid using
the request pointer after it may have been freed.
And hold an extra reference in kick_requests() while handling
a linger request that has not yet been registered
it doesn't go away.
This resolves:
http://tracker.ceph.com/issues/3859
